# Main Results

## Mathematics and propositions

::: {.proposition title="Proposition 1"}
For independent observations with finite variance,

$$
\operatorname{Var}(\bar{X}) = \frac{\sigma^2}{n}.
$$
:::

Typst supports mathematical notation through Pandoc's conversion.
